lessons.description: Describe your daily routine, from getting up to going to bed
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 先…再… / 就 / 常常

grammar.title: 先…再… — first…, then…
grammar.note: 先 marks the first action, 再 the next one. Both go before their verbs. 再 also means 'again' for something that hasn't happened yet: 明天再来.

grammar.title: 就 — as soon as, right after
grammar.pattern: 我七点起床，七点半就上班了。
grammar.note: 就 before a verb shows that something happens early or quickly: 他六点就起床了 = he was already up at six. 马上 means 'right away': 我马上来.

grammar.title: 常常 / 有时候 — how often
grammar.pattern: 我常常在家吃饭，有时候在饭店吃。
grammar.note: Frequency words go before the verb. 常常 (or 常) = often; 有时候 (or 有时) = sometimes. The negative of 常常 is 不常.

sentences.zh: 我早上六点半起床。
sentences.en: I get up at 6:30 in the morning.

sentences.zh: 我先洗手，再吃早饭。
sentences.en: First I wash my hands, then I have breakfast.

sentences.zh: 爸爸八点上班，下午五点下班。
sentences.en: Dad starts work at eight and finishes at five.

sentences.zh: 我很累，我想休息一会儿。
sentences.en: I'm tired; I'd like to rest for a bit.

sentences.zh: 她工作很忙，常常不在家。
sentences.en: She's busy at work and often not home.

sentences.zh: 晚上我有时候看电视，有时候看书。
sentences.en: In the evening I sometimes watch TV and sometimes read.

sentences.zh: 你在哪儿？— 我在家里，马上就来！
sentences.en: Where are you? — At home. I'll be right there!

sentences.zh: 他十点就睡觉了。
sentences.en: He went to bed at ten already.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Are you busy today?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 很忙。我七点就上班了，现在还没下班。
dialogue.en: Very. I started work at seven and I'm still not done.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: You must be tired.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Very. I want to go home and sleep first.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 好，你好好休息，明天再说。
dialogue.en: OK, get some good rest. We'll talk tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: OK, see you tomorrow!

lines.zh: 我妈妈是工人，她的工作很忙。
lines.en: My mom is a factory worker. Her job keeps her busy.

lines.zh: 她早上六点起床，先做早饭，再去上班。
lines.en: She gets up at six, makes breakfast first, then goes to work.

lines.zh: 下午六点下班，回家就做晚饭。
lines.en: She finishes at six p.m. and makes dinner as soon as she's home.

lines.zh: 晚上她常常很累，九点半就睡觉了。
lines.en: In the evening she's often tired and goes to bed by 9:30.

lines.zh: 星期六和星期天妈妈不上班，在家休息。
lines.en: On Saturdays and Sundays Mom doesn't work; she rests at home.

lines.zh: 她有时候看电视，有时候和我们去饭店吃饭。
lines.en: Sometimes she watches TV, sometimes she goes to a restaurant with us.

lines.zh: 我和爸爸常常先做饭，再叫妈妈来吃。
lines.en: Dad and I often cook first, then call Mom to come and eat.

questions.question: 妈妈几点下班？
questions.questionEn: When does Mom finish work?

questions.question: 妈妈先去上班，再做早饭。
questions.questionEn: Mom goes to work first, then makes breakfast.

questions.question: 星期六妈妈也要上班。
questions.questionEn: Mom has to work on Saturdays too.

questions.question: 妈妈的工作怎么样？
questions.questionEn: What is Mom's job like?

lines.zh: A：晚上你在家吗？
lines.en: A: Are you home this evening?

lines.zh: B：在家。我想看电视。
lines.en: B: Yes. I want to watch TV.

lines.zh: A：你家的电视机是新的吗？
lines.en: A: Is your TV new?

lines.zh: B：是，很大！你来我家看吧。
lines.en: B: Yes, it's big! Come over and watch.

lines.zh: A：好，我马上就去。
lines.en: A: OK, I'll come right over.

questions.question: B 晚上不在家。
questions.questionEn: B won't be home this evening.

questions.question: B 晚上想做什么？
questions.questionEn: What does B want to do this evening?

lessons.description: Describe your home and room, and say where you live
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 住在 / 着 / 的 phrases

grammar.title: 住在 + place — live in
grammar.pattern: 我住在北京。他住在三楼。
grammar.note: 住在 + place says where someone lives. 楼 is a building or floor: 三楼 = third floor; 楼上 / 楼下 = upstairs / downstairs.

grammar.title: Verb + 着 — a lasting state
grammar.pattern: 门开着。桌子上放着电脑。
grammar.note: 着 after a verb shows a state that continues: 门开着 = the door is open (and stays open). Place + verb + 着 + thing describes a scene.

grammar.title: 放 / 拿 — put and take
grammar.pattern: 书放在桌子上。你拿着什么？
grammar.note: 放 = put, place: 放在床上. 拿 = take, pick up, hold: 你拿着什么？ 打开 = open, turn on; 关上 = close (a door); 关电脑 = turn off a computer.

sentences.zh: 你住在哪儿？— 我住在学校旁边。
sentences.en: Where do you live? — Next to the school.

sentences.zh: 我们的房子不大，有三个房间。
sentences.en: Our house isn't big; it has three rooms.

sentences.zh: 我的房间在楼上，很干净。
sentences.en: My room is upstairs, and it's clean.

sentences.zh: 门开着，请关上门。
sentences.en: The door is open — please close it.

sentences.zh: 电脑放在桌子上。
sentences.en: The computer is on the table.

sentences.zh: 地上有一个包，是谁的？
sentences.en: There's a bag on the floor. Whose is it?

sentences.zh: 这个房子很老，有一个房间的门坏了。
sentences.en: This house is old; one room's door is broken.

sentences.zh: 请打开电脑。
sentences.en: Please turn on the computer.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Is your new room big?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Not big, but it's clean and I like it.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What's in the room?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 房间里有床和桌子，桌子上放着电脑。
dialogue.en: There's a bed and a table, with my computer on the table.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Which floor do you live on?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: The fifth. There's a shop right downstairs.

lines.zh: 我们家住在一个老楼里，我家在四楼。
lines.en: We live in an old building, on the fourth floor.

lines.zh: 房子不大，有两个房间。
lines.en: The flat isn't big — it has two rooms.

lines.zh: 我的房间很干净，床在门的左边。
lines.en: My room is clean. The bed is to the left of the door.

lines.zh: 桌子上放着我的电脑和一些书。
lines.en: My computer and some books are on the table.

lines.zh: 电脑旁边有一个新杯子，是妈妈买的。
lines.en: Next to the computer is a new cup that Mom bought.

lines.zh: 楼下有一个小商店，我常常去那儿买水果。
lines.en: There's a small shop downstairs; I often buy fruit there.

lines.zh: 晚上我关上门，在房间里看书。
lines.en: In the evening I close the door and read in my room.

questions.question: 他家在几楼？
questions.questionEn: Which floor is his home on?

questions.question: 床在门的右边。
questions.questionEn: The bed is to the right of the door.

questions.question: 楼下有什么？
questions.questionEn: What is downstairs?

questions.question: 他的房间里有床、电脑和书。
questions.questionEn: His room has a bed, a computer and books.

lines.zh: A：你在门口干什么？
lines.en: A: What are you doing at the door?

lines.zh: B：门关着，我进不去。
lines.en: B: The door is shut and I can't get in.

lines.zh: A：你没拿手机吗？
lines.en: A: Didn't you bring your phone?

lines.zh: B：手机在房间里！
lines.en: B: It's in the room!

lines.zh: A：没事儿，我给你打开。
lines.en: A: No problem, I'll open it for you.

questions.question: B 的手机在房间里。
questions.questionEn: B's phone is in the room.

questions.question: B 在哪儿？
questions.questionEn: Where is B?

lessons.description: Talk about weather and compare things
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 比 / 一样 / 最

grammar.title: A 比 B + adjective
grammar.pattern: 今天比昨天冷。哥哥比我高。
grammar.note: 比 compares two things: 'A is more … than B'. Don't add 很 after 比: say 今天比昨天冷, not 今天比昨天很冷.

grammar.title: A 跟 B 一样 — the same as
grammar.note: 跟 … 一样 = 'as … as' / 'the same'. Add an adjective after 一样 to say in what way: 一样高, 一样好看.

grammar.title: 最 / 非常 / 真 — degree
grammar.pattern: 一月最冷。今天非常热。这儿的花真好看！
grammar.note: 最 = the most. 非常 = very, extremely (stronger than 很). 真 + adjective is an exclamation: 'so…!'. 觉得 = to feel, think: 我觉得今天不冷.

sentences.zh: 今天天气好吗？
sentences.en: Is the weather nice today?

sentences.zh: 今天很冷，下雨了。
sentences.en: It's cold today, and it's started raining.

sentences.zh: 今天比昨天热。
sentences.en: Today is hotter than yesterday.

sentences.zh: 外边风很大。
sentences.en: It's very windy outside.

sentences.zh: 山上的树和花真好看！
sentences.en: The trees and flowers on the mountain are so pretty!

sentences.zh: 我觉得北京跟这里一样冷。
sentences.en: I think Beijing is as cold as here.

sentences.zh: 这是我们这儿最高的山。
sentences.en: This is the highest mountain around here.

sentences.zh: 明天真的下雨吗？
sentences.en: Is it really going to rain tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Is it raining outside?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: No, but it's very windy.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Is it cold?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Really cold! Much colder than yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Then let's stay in today.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: OK, I think staying home is best too.

lines.zh: 星期天天气非常好，不冷也不热。
lines.en: Sunday's weather was great — not cold, not hot.

lines.zh: 我和朋友去山上玩儿。
lines.en: My friend and I went up the mountain.

lines.zh: 山很高，山上有很多树和花。
lines.en: The mountain is high, with lots of trees and flowers.

lines.zh: 白的花最好看，我们都觉得这里真好！
lines.en: The white flowers were the prettiest. We both thought it was wonderful here!

lines.zh: 山上比山下冷一点儿，风也很大。
lines.en: It was a bit colder at the top than below, and very windy.

lines.zh: 我们在山上吃了一些面包和水果。
lines.en: We ate some bread and fruit on the mountain.

lines.zh: 下午四点下雨了，我们就回家了。
lines.en: At four in the afternoon it started raining, so we went home.

questions.question: 星期天天气好吗？
questions.questionEn: Was the weather good on Sunday?

questions.question: 他们觉得白的花最好看。
questions.questionEn: They thought the white flowers were the prettiest.

questions.question: 山上比山下热。
questions.questionEn: It was hotter on the mountain than below.

questions.question: 下午四点他们做什么了？
questions.questionEn: What did they do at four in the afternoon?

lines.zh: A：北京冷还是这儿冷？
lines.en: A: Is Beijing colder, or here?

lines.zh: B：北京比这儿冷。
lines.en: B: Beijing is colder than here.

lines.zh: A：北京常常下雨吗？
lines.en: A: Does it rain often in Beijing?

lines.zh: B：不常下雨，风很大。
lines.en: B: Not often, but it's very windy.

lines.zh: A：北京几月最冷？我明年一月想去北京。
lines.en: A: Which month is coldest in Beijing? I want to go next January.

lines.zh: B：一月最冷，你要多穿一点儿衣服。
lines.en: B: January is coldest — you should wear more clothes.

lines.zh: A：这儿一月也冷吗？我觉得这儿的天气真好。
lines.en: A: Is it cold here in January too? I think the weather here is great.

lines.zh: B：这儿一月不太冷，跟北京的三月一样。
lines.en: B: January here isn't very cold — it's like March in Beijing.

questions.question: 这儿比北京冷。
questions.questionEn: It's colder here than in Beijing.

questions.question: 北京不常下雨，风很大。
questions.questionEn: It doesn't often rain in Beijing, but it's windy.

questions.question: A 明年几月想去北京？
questions.questionEn: Which month does A want to go to Beijing next year?

questions.question: B 觉得 A 去北京要多穿衣服。
questions.questionEn: B thinks A should wear more clothes in Beijing.

lessons.description: Say you're ill, see a doctor and ask for time off
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 能 / 别 / 不用

grammar.title: 能 — can (able / allowed)
grammar.pattern: 我今天不能上课。你能来吗？
grammar.note: 能 + verb says whether you are able or allowed to do something now: 我生病了，不能去. Compare 会 (a learned skill).

grammar.title: 别 + verb — don't
grammar.pattern: 别动！· 你别去上班了。
grammar.note: 别 tells someone not to do something. Add 了 at the end to say 'stop / don't anymore'. 不用 + verb = there's no need to: 不用去医院.

grammar.title: 生病 vs 病
grammar.pattern: 我生病了。· 他的病好了。
grammar.note: 生病 is the verb phrase 'to fall ill'. 病 is the illness itself; 病了 = to be ill, common in speech: 我病了. 看病 = to see a doctor (for the patient) or to treat patients (for the doctor).

sentences.zh: 我生病了，今天不能去上班。
sentences.en: I'm ill; I can't go to work today.

sentences.zh: 你怎么了？— 我的手不能动了。
sentences.en: What's wrong? — I can't move my hand.

sentences.zh: 我们去医院看病吧。
sentences.en: Let's go to the hospital to see a doctor.

sentences.zh: 医生说我多休息就好了。
sentences.en: The doctor said I'll be fine if I rest a lot.

sentences.zh: 别动，我看看你的手。
sentences.en: Don't move — let me look at your hand.

sentences.zh: 你身体好吗？
sentences.en: Are you in good health?

sentences.zh: 不用去医院，在家休息吧。
sentences.en: No need to go to the hospital; rest at home.

sentences.zh: 我病了，想请假。
sentences.en: I'm ill and want to take time off.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 王老师，我生病了，想请假。
dialogue.en: Teacher Wang, I'm ill and I'd like to take the day off.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Have you been to the hospital?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 去了。医生说我要多休息。
dialogue.en: Yes. The doctor said I need plenty of rest.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: OK, don't come to class tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you, teacher!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: You're welcome. Your health comes first!

lines.zh: 昨天我的手不能动了。
lines.en: Yesterday I couldn't move my hand.

lines.zh: 妈妈和我去医院看病。
lines.en: Mom and I went to the hospital.

lines.zh: 医院里病人很多，我们等了一个小时。
lines.en: There were lots of patients; we waited an hour.

lines.zh: 医生说不是大病，不用住在医院，多休息就好。
lines.en: The doctor said it wasn't serious — no need to stay in hospital, just rest.

lines.zh: 第二天我请假了，在家休息了一天。
lines.en: The next day I took leave and rested at home all day.

lines.zh: 同学们打电话问我：“你的手好了吗？”
lines.en: My classmates called and asked, 'Is your hand better?'

lines.zh: 现在我的手好了，明天就能去上课了。
lines.en: Now my hand is better, and tomorrow I can go to class.

questions.question: 他要住在医院里。
questions.questionEn: He has to stay in the hospital.

questions.question: 他们在医院等了一个小时。
questions.questionEn: They waited an hour at the hospital.

questions.question: 第二天他做什么了？
questions.questionEn: What did he do the next day?

questions.question: 他的病不是大病。
questions.questionEn: His illness wasn't serious.

lines.zh: A：你怎么了？
lines.en: A: What's the matter?

lines.zh: B：我身上很热，我病了。
lines.en: B: I feel very hot all over. I'm ill.

lines.zh: A：别去上课了，在家休息吧。
lines.en: A: Don't go to class. Rest at home.

lines.zh: B：好，我给老师打电话请假。
lines.en: B: OK, I'll call my teacher and ask for the day off.

questions.question: B 今天去上课。
questions.questionEn: B goes to class today.

questions.question: B 给谁打电话？
questions.questionEn: Who does B call?

lessons.description: Talk about what you like doing in your free time
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 喜欢 + verb / 一起

grammar.title: 喜欢 / 爱 + verb
grammar.note: 喜欢 and 爱 can take a whole activity: 喜欢看电影. 爱 is stronger, 'to love (doing)'. 你的爱好是什么？asks about hobbies.

grammar.title: 一起 / 一块儿 + verb — together
grammar.note: 一起 goes before the verb. 一块儿 means the same and is very common in northern speech. Often with 跟: 我跟朋友一起打球.

grammar.title: 好 + verb — good to…
grammar.pattern: 好听 · 好看 · 好吃 · 好玩儿
grammar.note: 好 before a sense verb makes an adjective: 好听 = nice to listen to, 好玩儿 = fun. Negative: 不好听.

sentences.zh: 你的爱好是什么？
sentences.en: What are your hobbies?

sentences.zh: 我喜欢唱歌，也喜欢看电影。
sentences.en: I like singing and watching films.

sentences.zh: 这个歌非常好听。
sentences.en: This song is really nice.

sentences.zh: 星期六我们一起去电影院吧。
sentences.en: Let's go to the cinema together on Saturday.

sentences.zh: 他爱打球，常常跟同学一块儿玩儿。
sentences.en: He loves playing ball and often plays with classmates.

sentences.zh: 我早上常常走路，走一个小时。
sentences.en: I often walk for an hour in the morning.

sentences.zh: 她喜欢上网，有很多网友。
sentences.en: She likes going online and has lots of online friends.

sentences.zh: 我用手机在网上看电影。
sentences.en: I watch films online on my phone.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What hobbies do you have?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I love playing ball. You?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I like singing and films.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 明天有一个新电影，听说很好看。
dialogue.en: There's a new film out tomorrow. It's supposed to be good.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 真的吗？我们一起去看吧！
dialogue.en: Really? Let's go see it together!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 好！明天下午电影院门口见。
dialogue.en: OK! See you outside the cinema tomorrow afternoon.

lines.zh: 我有一个网友，她叫小白。
lines.en: I have an online friend called Xiaobai.

lines.zh: 我们都爱唱歌，常常在网上一起唱。
lines.en: We both love singing and often sing together online.

lines.zh: 她唱歌非常好听。
lines.en: She sings beautifully.

lines.zh: 下个星期她来北京，我们想一块儿去玩儿。
lines.en: Next week she's coming to Beijing; we want to go out together.

lines.zh: 我们先去电影院看电影。
lines.en: First we'll go to the cinema to see a film.

lines.zh: 那个电影非常好看，我们都很喜欢。
lines.en: That film is great; we both like it a lot.

lines.zh: 晚上我们去饭店吃饭，她说北京的菜很好吃。
lines.en: In the evening we'll eat at a restaurant; she says Beijing food is delicious.

questions.question: 他们的爱好是什么？
questions.questionEn: What hobby do they share?

questions.question: 小白下个星期来北京。
questions.questionEn: Xiaobai is coming to Beijing next week.

questions.question: 他们先去哪儿？
questions.questionEn: Where will they go first?

questions.question: 小白不在北京住。
questions.questionEn: Xiaobai doesn't live in Beijing.

lines.zh: A：下午你有时间吗？我们去打球吧！
lines.en: A: Are you free this afternoon? Let's go play ball!

lines.zh: B：好啊！在哪儿打？
lines.en: B: Sure! Where?

lines.zh: A：在学校。你有球吗？
lines.en: A: At school. Do you have a ball?

lines.zh: B：有，我拿球去。
lines.en: B: Yes, I'll bring one.

lines.zh: A：太好了，打球真好玩儿！
lines.en: A: Great — playing ball is so much fun!

questions.question: 他们在学校打球。
questions.questionEn: They're playing ball at school.

questions.question: 谁拿球？
questions.questionEn: Who brings the ball?
